verdict.rationale: AgentMail is email infrastructure that external agents use through an API, MCP server, CLI and framework integrations. Nothing in the evidence shows a built-in AI assistant inside the product to which a user can delegate tasks. The MCP server, skills and integrations are building blocks for the user's own agents, not a native assistant, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
